requirements.title: NEWUNIT= requires FILE= or STATUS=SCRATCH
requirements.definition: If NEWUNIT= appears in an OPEN statement, either FILE= shall appear or STATUS= shall appear with value SCRATCH.

requirements.title: Successful NEWUNIT= OPEN defines the variable with a processor-determined value
requirements.definition: If no error occurs during OPEN execution, the NEWUNIT= variable is defined with a processor-determined NEWUNIT value.

pending.newunit-success-defines-variable: Initialize the NEWUNIT variable to a positive sentinel, OPEN with STATUS=SCRATCH, assert IOSTAT zero and that the variable changed to a valid NEWUNIT property such as negative and not -1.
pending.newunit-value-processor-determined: No portable oracle exists for the exact NEWUNIT number chosen by the processor; future fixtures must avoid asserting a particular processor choice.

NEWUNIT value properties combine numeric restrictions, excluded named constants, uniqueness, and preconnection restriction.

review_rationale: Source registration for the OPEN statement and its specifiers, 12.5.6.1-12.5.6.19 (batch151). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across four rounds. Round 1 found required OPEN defaults with only generic plans and required default tokens over-suppressed as unobservable; both are now concrete sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE plans (ACCESS, ASYNCHRONOUS, BLANK, DECIMAL, DELIM, FORM, PAD, LEADING_ZERO, SIGN, and ROUND as set membership). Rounds 2 and 3 found that INQUIRE(POSITION=) reports connection STATE, not the omitted OPEN token, and that a re-OPEN plan observes 12.5.6.1 p6 rather than the POSITION default; the omitted POSITION= token is now recorded as not portably observable, as are the STATUS and ENCODING default tokens. The eight numbered rules R1204-R1207 and C1203-C1206 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
